title: MODAVIS Scriptor v0.1.0

creators.name: Ukolov, Dominik
creators.affiliation: Digital Humanities (Image/Object), Friedrich Schiller University Jena; Research Group DIGITAL ORGANOLOGY, Leipzig University

description:
MODAVIS Scriptor is a local research application for extracting visible text from images, reviewing readings against the source, and exporting structured results with processing provenance. Version 0.1.0 provides a specialized mode for photographed pipe-organ stops and a general visible-text mode.

The application separates immutable OCR, advisory MODAVIS corpus matches and explicit human decisions. Review events record the reviewer, rationale, field values, region version and timestamp. Reprocessing creates a new run. Exports include Markdown, CSV, JSON and a research bundle containing source images, OCR inputs and outputs, coordinates, checksums, configuration and review history.

The release includes Docker Compose definitions, locked dependencies, OCR models, a MODAVIS POD 1.5.0 retrieval projection and an immediately viewable organ-stop example. The photograph is by Tucker501, Organ-stops.jpg (2020), Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0. Its original bytes, source attribution and separately identified processing derivatives are included. The corpus projection derives from MODAVIS Pipe Organ Dataset 1.5.0, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22234059.

Version 0.1.0 is intended for local single-user research use. OCR and detection results require review; no general accuracy benchmark is claimed. Private manuscript collections are not included.
notes: The original application and documentation use CC BY 4.0. The included photograph and its adaptations retain CC BY-SA 4.0; Tesseract tessdata_best model files retain Apache License 2.0. Third-party notices and source-specific rights are included in the archive.
